outcome: Vaginal microbiota composition (16S rRNA gene sequencing)
Vaginal microbiota α-diversity (Observed, Shannon, Chao1, Simpson indexes)
Vaginal metabolites (alpha-hydroxyalprazolam, LPE (18:1(9Z)/0:0), PS(16:0/15:0), N-acetylhistamine, carnitine, pseudouridine, allopregnanolone)
Clinical characteristics (white blood cell (WBC), neutrophil, lymphocyte, monocytes, platelet, NLR, PLR, SII, SIRI, C-reactive protein (CRP))
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women who underwent cervical cerclage.
finding: Cervical cerclage significantly altered the relative abundance of specific vaginal bacteria (Muribaculaceae, Blautia, Sneathia) and 19 metabolites in pregnant women, although clinical characteristics and α-diversity of the microbiota remained unchanged.
